name: age
source_detail: Date of birth on PAN / Aadhaar
description: Applicant age in completed years at application

name: employment_type
source_detail: Declared; verified via salary slips or ITR

name: employer_category
allowed_values: govt | psu | mnc | listed | pvt_ltd | llp | proprietorship | none
source_detail: Declared; verified via employer ID / lender's employer master list
description: Type of employer; proxy for job stability. 'none' for self-employed

name: net_monthly_income
source_detail: Last 3 salary slips / bank statement salary credits
description: Take-home monthly salary after tax and deductions

name: business_vintage_months
description: Months the business or practice has been running

name: total_work_exp_months
source_detail: Declared; verified via EPFO / experience letters
description: Total months of employment across employers

name: current_job_months
source_detail: Declared; verified via EPFO / appointment letter

name: city
used_by_rules: derives city_tier; serviceable_cities (Axis lends in 65 listed cities)

name: city_tier
source_detail: Derived from the applicant's city. Metro = Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad

name: credit_score
description: Bureau score; null for new-to-credit applicants

name: max_dpd_12m
description: Worst days-past-due on any account in last 12 months

name: enquiries_6m
description: Hard credit enquiries in last 6 months

name: has_writeoff_or_settlement
description: Any written-off or settled account in history

name: existing_emi
source_detail: Sum of EMIs on active loans (+ 5% of card outstanding if any); confirmed with applicant

name: salary_account_with
used_by_rules: salary_account_required, every rule@rel and rule@govt_rel (income floor, loan cap, FOIR, tenure, rate band at SBI, BoB, Axis, Kotak, PNB)
description: Bank where salary is credited (existing relationship)

name: requested_tenure_months
description: Tenure wanted (clipped to each lender's range)
